rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the coconut fruit or its hard-shelled seed/nut.

example.english: I bought a coconut to take home.
example.traditional: 我買咗一個椰子返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 je4 zi2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the edible white flesh inside a coconut.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 je4 juk6

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the coconut palm or tree rather than its fruit.

example.english: That coconut palm over there is very tall.
example.jyutping: go2 bin1 fo2 je4 zi2 syu6 hou2 gou1
